system.description:
Requirements: Borrow the Current, and you must be utilizing Frost Dragon Style

Cost: 1-3 Focus

Your martial practice and arcane knowledge of the Water have come to harmonize with each other, and you know how to flow from one to the other.

When you make a casting check for a spell with the Water trait, you may spend up to 3 Focus, before or after rolling: you gain +1 bonus Expertise on that check per Focus spent.

Additionally, ending your turn after casting a spell with the Water trait activates Channel the Current from Frost Dragon Style, granting you an additional +1 Focus.
